headline.purpose: The page title. The masthead name is the same face at 1.125rem and 700.

title.purpose: The vehicle label on a card and in the dialog.

body.purpose: Filters, coordinates, buttons, the footer, and the refresh line.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows and dialog field names, in Ledger Gray.

shadows.name: menu-overlay
shadows.purpose: The open route or trip menu only, so the list reads above the sheet.

motion.name: focus-outline

motion.name: pin-glide

components.name: Mark Button
components.description: Paging and retry. Mark Blue fill, Sheet text, 4px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-mark { font-family: var(--font-sans, "PT Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.43; background: var(--color-bar, #174da1); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-mark:hover { background: var(--color-bar, #174da1); } .ds-btn-mark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue, #0846a1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-mark:disabled { background: var(--color-line, #cdd6e4); color: var(--color-muted, #5b5b5b); cursor: default; }

components.name: Ground Button
components.description: Muat ulang. Ground Blue fill, Sheet text, same control metrics as Mark.
components.css: .ds-btn-ground { font-family: var(--font-sans, "PT Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.43; background: var(--color-blue, #0846a1); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ground:hover { background: var(--color-blue, #0846a1); } .ds-btn-ground:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue, #0846a1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ground:disabled { background: var(--color-line, #cdd6e4); color: var(--color-muted, #5b5b5b); cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: A retry or clear action. Desk Navy, weight 700, underlined when it retries.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { font-family: var(--font-sans, "PT Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.43; background: transparent; color: var(--color-navy, #06367c); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-text:hover { color: var(--color-navy, #06367c); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue, #0846a1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: The closed route or trip menu. White, hairline Rule Gray, Mark Blue caret.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans, "PT Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--color-navy, #06367c); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.43; } .ds-field-control { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 240px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-navy, #06367c); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #cdd6e4); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-field-control:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-field-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue, #0846a1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-control:disabled { background: var(--color-field, #ebf3f9); color: var(--color-muted, #5b5b5b); cursor: default; }

components.name: Vehicle Card
components.description: White sheet, 16px radius, hairline border, full-bleed Mark Blue strip. The badge color is route data; the sample is not a shell token.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-navy, #06367c); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #cdd6e4); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-sans, "PT Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-bar { height: 4px; background: var(--color-bar, #174da1); } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-body:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-card-body:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue, #0846a1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; } .ds-kicker { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted, #5b5b5b); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.333; } .ds-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #da291c; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-bar, #174da1); color: #ffffff; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.333; } .ds-chip-label { font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-code { font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-card-meta, .ds-card-time { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.43; } .ds-card-time { color: var(--color-muted, #5b5b5b); }

components.css: .ds-menu { width: 280px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #cdd6e4); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); font-family: var(--font-sans, "PT Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-menu-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-panel, #cde6fd); color: var(--color-navy, #06367c); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-row:hover { background: var(--color-panel, #cde6fd); } .ds-menu-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-blue, #0846a1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check { display: grid; flex: none; } .ds-menu-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #da291c; color: #ffffff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-menu-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-menu-name, .ds-menu-desc { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-menu-name { font-weight: 700; } .ds-menu-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-muted, #5b5b5b); }

narrative.overview:
The board is a desk. A Desk Navy band stays pinned to the top, a white sheet holds the work, and a Ground Blue footer closes the page. The voice is calm and institutional: bold PT Sans, short blue bars, and pale bands, the way a public-service counter stays quiet so the record can be read.

Density stays even. The page title is large and is followed by one short mark. Filters sit in a pale band. Vehicles are a grid of white cards. The vehicle label, the status, and the time do the talking. Route color is allowed where it identifies a route: the round badge, and the line on the map.

The public TransJakarta site supplies this shell: the navy, the blue ground, PT Sans, and the short bar. Confirmed rejections are its logo, its homepage, and its marketing layout, along with gradients, illustration, and a hero.
keyCharacteristics: Flat bands of color, with one menu shadow
A short Mark Blue bar as the only ornament
Route color confined to the badge and the map

rules.name: The Route Color Rule
rules.body: A route's color comes from the API. It paints the round badge and the map line, and nothing else in the shell. When the API sends no color, the fallback is Mark Blue.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Mark Blue is the bar, the moving-vehicle chip, and the paging controls. It does not become a second page background.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: PT Sans only, at 400 and 700. No second family, and no italic, on the board.

rules.name: The Label and the Code Rule
rules.body: A status pill shows the Indonesian word in 700 and the raw API code beside it at 400 and 80% opacity. The code stays visible.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: The work sits on Sheet. Ground Blue is the page behind that sheet and the footer. The filter band is Band Pale on the sheet.

rules.name: The Flat Band Rule
rules.body: A resting surface does not lift. A card does not gain a shadow on hover, and the board does not fade while a refresh is in flight.

rules.name: The Overlay Rule
rules.body: The menu shadow is an overlay, not a material. It is not reused on cards, buttons, or the dialog.

rules.name: The Two Radius Rule
rules.body: 4px for a control, 16px for a surface, a circle only for a status or a route badge.

dos: Do keep the page ground Ground Blue and the working surface Sheet.
Do mark the page title with a 4px by 48px Mark Blue bar, and each card with a full-bleed 4px strip of the same color.
Do keep a card flat: 16px radius, a 1px Rule Gray border, and 16px of padding.
Do show keyboard focus as a 2px Ground Blue outline, 2px outside the control.
Do show a status as a pill: the Indonesian word at 700, the raw code at 400 and 80% opacity.
Do paint the route badge and the map line with the API route color, and fall back to Mark Blue when that color is missing.
donts: Don't copy the TransJakarta logo, homepage, or marketing layout.
Don't add a hero, a gradient, an illustration, or a second typeface.
Don't put a shadow on a card, a button, or the dialog.
Don't recolor a button on hover.
Don't fade the vehicle cards while a refresh is in flight.
Don't use a route's API color for the masthead, the footer, a button, or the page background.
Don't round the dialog at 640px and below. At that width it is a square, full-viewport sheet.
